title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Joshua 22: the eastern tribes return home and build an altar by the Jordan.

questions.text: Which tribes did Joshua call at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:1 says Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

answers.text: Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh
Judah, Benjamin and the tribe of Simeon
Ephraim, Dan and the tribe of Asher

questions.text: Where had Moses given one half-tribe of Manasseh its inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:7 says Moses had given the one half-tribe of Manasseh inheritance in Bashan.

questions.text: What did Joshua tell them to do with the plunder of their enemies?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 22:8 Joshua says, "Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers."

answers.text: Give it all to the priests

questions.text: What did the eastern tribes build by the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:10 says they built an altar by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

questions.text: Who was sent to the land of Gilead to speak with them?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:13 says the children of Israel sent Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

questions.text: How many princes went with him?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:14 says ten princes went with him, one prince of a fathers' house for each of the tribes of Israel.

questions.text: The delegation recalled "the iniquity of" which place?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 22:17 they ask, "Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us?"

questions.text: Whose trespass in the devoted thing did the delegation mention?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:20 asks whether Achan the son of Zerah did not commit a trespass in the devoted thing.

questions.text: After hearing their answer, what did Phinehas say they now knew?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 22:31 Phinehas says, "Today we know that Yahweh is among us."

answers.text: That the altar must be torn down
That the tribes must leave Gilead
That war could not be avoided

questions.text: What name did Reuben and Gad give the altar?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:34 says they named the altar "A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God."

answers.text: "A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God"
"The Altar of the Three Tribes by the Jordan"
"A Memorial of the Crossing of the Jordan"
"The Stone of Help Between the Tribes"
